name: NeRF-guided MDE Adaptation
definition: A process to adapt the pre-trained MDE network to the specific scene's absolute geometry using NeRF as a prior, resolving ambiguities like convexity/concavity and orientation.
summary: NeRF-guided MDE Adaptation refines monocular depth estimation by adapting its weights to a scene's absolute geometry via a NeRF prior, distinguishing itself by explicit weight adaptation rather than static supervision.
